messages:
Alex: Hey @Sam (Auditor) — attaching the artifact bundle for the RBAC + KMS questions from yesterday. Short summary: rotated the key on 2026-03-18, recorded CloudTrail entries, and captured rolebinding diffs for the service account change. :white_check_mark:
Maria: Thanks. can you point to the exact CloudTrail events we should look at? auditor asked for the envelope key usage proof and the key policy change history.
Ken: CloudTrail event IDs are included in the bundle. Example entries: Encrypt/Decrypt calls and KMS:ScheduleKeyDeletion/DisableKey. We also included the KMS key policy snapshot and the alias history.
Alex: Pasting the quick retrieval commands I used to assemble the bundle:
```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit-bundles/2026-03-18/kms-rbac-bundle-1768642000.tar.gz .
tar -xzvf kms-rbac-bundle-1768642000.tar.gz
grep -i "kms:Encrypt\|kms:Decrypt\|UpdateKeyPolicy" cloudtrail/*.json | head -n 50
```
Maria: The RBAC change is PR #5123 — we added a constrained rolebinding for the inference-service SA. Snapshot file is `rbac-snapshots/2026-03-17-to-2026-03-19.diff` inside the bundle.
Sam (Auditor): Got it, thx. For the envelope-key mapping, can you show the KMS key ARN that was used by the inference service during the incident window (2026-03-18 02:00-05:00 UTC)? Need a concrete ARNs + matching CloudTrail event IDs.
Ken: Sure — look for arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789 in `cloudtrail/kms_calls.json`. Example event snippet we included: `eventTime: 2026-03-18T02:22:11Z, eventName: Encrypt, requestParameters: { keyId: "arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789" }`.
Alex: Also noted: we rotated the key on 2026-03-18T01:00:00Z (scheduled rotation completed). Bundle contains `rotation-log/rotation_metadata.csv` and a signed rotation manifest `rotation-manifest.sig` for chain of custody.
ComplianceBot: Export job complete — s3://redwood-audit-bundles/2026-03-18/kms-rbac-bundle-1768642000.tar.gz (expires in 7 days). :package:
Sam (Auditor): Can you confirm retention settings for these logs? Auditor needs proof log retention >= 1 year and the current retention policy in our Splunk/S3 ingestion flow.
Maria: Logs are forwarded to our long-term S3 archive with lifecycle 395 days. See `ingest/config-retention.txt` in the bundle (policy: s3://redwood-logs-archive/lifecycle.json). I also included a Splunk index export `splunk-export-2026-03-18.tgz` for the specific event window.
Ken: For RBAC provenance, included screenshots + YAML of rolebindings before/after, and the Git commit that introduced the change: commit abcdef12345 in infra-repo. Also added the PR review thread link.
Alex: One tricky item the auditor flagged — they want to see evidence that the rotated key had no active decrypt grants to external partners during the rotation window. We verified active grants via `ListGrants` and included the output in `kms/grants-2026-03-18.json`. No external grantee IDs found.
Sam (Auditor): Good. Also need to understand the incident triage notes: was any data exfil possible while key rotation occurred? Looks like a short window where some tokens were reissued.
Maria: Incident notes are in `incidents/2026-03-18-inference-token-reissue.md`. TL;DR: a rolling restart caused some in-flight tokens to re-encrypt with the new key; no external network anomalies detected, no S3 object access outside normal patterns. We included outbound VPC flow logs for the window.
Ken: For completeness, added a signed statement from oncall (Samuel K.) confirming no anomalous principals were used. File: `incidents/signoffs/oncall-samuel-2026-03-19.sig`.
Alex: Action items for us: 1) confirm message to auditor with exact CloudTrail event IDs (I will enumerate), 2) provide redacted sample payload showing envelope metadata (we included a redacted example file), 3) confirm retention policy link in the compliance playbook.
Sam (Auditor): That should cover it. One more ask: can you provide the key policy diff that shows who had PutKeyPolicy permissions before/after? Need to see if admin privileges changed.
Maria: Yes — `kms/key_policy_diff_2026-03-16_2026-03-19.json` is in the bundle. The diff shows only a minor principal aliasing change for the security team, no new external principals added.
Alex: Sending the quick checklist to close this thread: CloudTrail event IDs, KMS ARN mapping, key policy diff, RBAC rolebinding diffs, signed rotation manifest, long-term retention policy link, incident triage note and oncall signoff.
Sam (Auditor): Perfect. I'll review and flag anything missing by EOD tomorrow. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Maria: FYI — if you need a narrower artifact set we can produce a minimal export (just events + policy diffs) to avoid sharing full payloads. Ping me.
Ken: Marking this resolved on our side pending auditor ACK.
Alex: Closing for now, will paste event IDs in a follow-up message once I finish the enumeration.
